description: What the binder accepts and refuses in LOOKUP (ADR-0016, ADR-0020, ADR-0046): the source is a table by name, the column one of its columns or COUNT, SUM, MIN or MAX over one expression of them, the condition a condition over the source's columns, with the document's variables as THIS.name; a query function does not nest inside another's arguments.
accept: LOOKUP(Rates, rate, code = THIS.code AND rate > DECIMAL(THIS.qty, 0))
LOOKUP(Rates, SUM(rate + rate), code = THIS.code AND active)
NUMBER(LOOKUP(Rates, SUM(rate), TRUE)) + LOOKUP(Rates, COUNT(code), TRUE)

unknown column
LOOKUP takes three arguments
the condition must be a condition; code is text
inside the condition a bare name is a column; the document's qty is THIS.qty
THIS names a variable the document lacks
THIS is only valid inside LOOKUP and QUERY
THIS outside a query function
